title: Start with the Home overview
steps: Check the account identity and the selected reporting dates.
Use the sidebar to open the workspace you need. The Home tiles summarize the current scope.
Open a detailed report before drawing conclusions from a headline number.

capture.source: Native browser PNG; no resizing or sharpening

title: Find guidance in the online manual
steps: Choose User Manual beneath Write with AI in the sidebar.
Enter a topic such as import, schedule, or unsubscribe in Search the manual.
Choose a matching topic or use the chapter navigation.

capture.source: Native browser PNG; no resizing or sharpening

title: Work in dark mode
steps: Use the account theme control to switch display mode.
The same navigation, filters, and actions remain available in either theme.
Check icon labels and status text as well as color when identifying an action.

capture.source: Native browser PNG; no resizing or sharpening

title: Use the workspace on a small screen
steps: Open the navigation menu to move between workspaces.
Close the menu to work with the current page.
Use horizontal scrolling where a table contains more columns than the screen can show.

capture.source: Native browser PNG; no resizing or sharpening

title: Read the online guide in dark mode
steps: Switch the account display to dark mode.
Use the same chapter links and search controls; the current role remains visible.
Open View Comprehensive User Guide to read or save the illustrated PDF.

capture.source: Native browser PNG; no resizing or sharpening

title: Read role permissions and protected-action cues
steps: Reviewer access focuses on browsing and analysis. Editors can change content and audience data.
Administrators have additional controls; sensitive actions may also require Admin Unlock.
Read the action label and confirmation before proceeding. An orange outline marks a protected control.

capture.source: Native browser PNG; no resizing or sharpening

title: Find and filter connections
steps: Search for a connection or narrow the list with filters.
Check the active or archived scope and the number of matching records.
Open the email address or name to review a profile before making changes.

capture.source: Native browser PNG; no resizing or sharpening

title: Review a connection profile
steps: Confirm the email address and subscription status.
Review profile fields, tags, groups, and the available activity or notes tabs.
Save each edited section and wait for confirmation.

capture.source: Native browser PNG; no resizing or sharpening

title: Begin a connection import
steps: Choose Import connections from Add connections.
Use an accepted file type and include an email column.
Continue to mapping and review before starting the import. Uploading a file alone does not complete the job.

capture.source: Native browser PNG; no resizing or sharpening

title: Match imported columns
steps: Inspect the example data beside each source column.
Map each column to the intended field and ignore columns that should not be imported.
Review consent, existing-record handling, and tags in the remaining steps before starting.

capture.source: Native browser PNG; no resizing or sharpening

title: Check import results
steps: Wait for the final job state rather than assuming that queued means complete.
Read the processed and rejected row counts and any available error details.
Verify sample profiles. Undo has a limited scope and does not restore every later edit.

capture.source: Native browser PNG; no resizing or sharpening

title: Find completed exports
steps: Start an export from the connection list or an individual profile.
Use Export history to review the job state and download a completed export.
Confirm the exported scope and keep audience data in an appropriate location.

capture.source: Native browser PNG; no resizing or sharpening

title: Use tag names to view their connections
steps: Create or locate an internal label with a clear purpose.
Click a tag name to open the associated connections.
Check the Active and Archived tabs. Archived tags keep existing assignments until they are restored.

capture.source: Native browser PNG; no resizing or sharpening

title: Manage subscriber interest groups
steps: Open an existing group or create a category for related choices.
Choose the display type and options that fit the question.
Check which choices appear in signup and preferences forms. The Archived view holds groups no longer available for new choices.

capture.source: Native browser PNG; no resizing or sharpening

title: Review fields and merge tags
steps: Review each field type, merge tag, required setting, and public visibility.
Use merge tags in content only after checking sample and missing values.
Removing a field can remove stored information; read the protected confirmation.

capture.source: Native browser PNG; no resizing or sharpening

title: Choose a reusable segment
steps: Open a segment to inspect its rules.
Review whether all rules or any rule must match and check the resulting connections.
Use the Archived view to find a retired segment; restore it before new targeting. Recheck recipient eligibility at send time.

capture.source: Native browser PNG; no resizing or sharpening

title: Manage email drafts and previous campaigns
steps: Search or filter the list by the scope you need.
Open a draft to continue its checklist, or create a new campaign.
After duplicating a campaign, recheck recipients, sender, dates, and links.

capture.source: Native browser PNG; no resizing or sharpening

title: Complete the campaign checklist
steps: Complete To, From, Subject, and Content using the available edit controls.
Review settings and tracking before finishing the draft.
Save and preview the content, then continue to the separate sending review when ready.

capture.source: Native browser PNG; no resizing or sharpening

title: Prepare a plain-text campaign
steps: Use the plain-text campaign type when a simple text message fits the task.
Review personalization, readable links, and the final subject.
Save the draft and run the same recipient and delivery checks used for other campaigns.

capture.source: Native browser PNG; no resizing or sharpening

title: Coordinate work in Campaign Manager
steps: Open a campaign plan to review its date range and touchpoints.
Add email, task, or event touchpoints to coordinate related work.
Check the linked email separately: a planning date is not proof that the email is scheduled.

capture.source: Native browser PNG; no resizing or sharpening

title: Choose a reusable email template
steps: Open a saved design or choose an available starter.
Replace example text, links, and images before use.
Save reusable designs with names that describe their purpose.

capture.source: Native browser PNG; no resizing or sharpening

title: Build the email in the visual editor
steps: Select a block in the email preview to open its content controls.
Use block and design settings for typography, spacing, images, and buttons.
Use Undo or Redo when needed, then Save and review the saved state.

capture.source: Native browser PNG; no resizing or sharpening

title: Review the email with your team
steps: Check the message content, subject, and preview text.
Use comments for specific corrections or questions.
Resolve the edits in the draft and verify them before the final sending review.

capture.source: Native browser PNG; no resizing or sharpening

title: Check the email preview before testing
steps: Open Preview and choose Enter preview mode.
Review the message with the available connection and device controls.
Check dates, links, personalization, and missing optional values before sending a test.

capture.source: Native browser PNG; no resizing or sharpening

title: Inspect the mobile email preview
steps: Choose Mobile in the preview toolbar.
Check text size, image proportions, button labels, and reading order.
Use Simulate dark mode as an additional check; inspect a real test message because email clients differ.

capture.source: Native browser PNG; no resizing or sharpening

title: Manage files for your campaigns
steps: Find or upload the image or document required for your message.
Use descriptive names and folders so the file is easy to find again.
Check image descriptions, link destinations, and how the asset appears in the final email.

capture.source: Native browser PNG; no resizing or sharpening

title: Set the Brand Kit
steps: Review the organization identity, logo, colors, and typography.
Use approved brand details as the starting point for new content.
Inspect existing drafts directly after a brand change; do not assume every saved design has changed.

capture.source: Native browser PNG; no resizing or sharpening

title: Read the send-readiness checks
steps: Confirm the intended campaign and recipients.
Read the sending review and resolve any blocked or incomplete item. Choose the send time in the campaign checklist before confirming.
Only continue to sending or scheduling when the required access and checks allow it. No example email was sent for this guide.

capture.source: Native browser PNG; no resizing or sharpening

title: Review administrative delivery setup
steps: An unrestricted administrator reviews the configured sender identity and delivery readiness.
Follow the on-screen checks for identity, configuration, and any required verification.
A saved draft or successful preview does not prove that an email can be delivered.

capture.source: Native browser PNG; no resizing or sharpening

title: Set the campaign delivery time
steps: Open Send time in the campaign checklist and choose Schedule or Send now.
For a schedule, review the delivery date, time, and time zone together, then save the choice.
Return to the final send review and confirm separately. Selecting a time in this form does not submit the campaign.

capture.source: Native browser PNG; no resizing or sharpening

title: Find an automation and its results
steps: Open a flow name to review its status and purpose.
Results appears before Edit in the row actions. Hover or focus an icon to read its label.
Keep a flow in draft while reviewing its trigger, conditions, and linked email content.

capture.source: Native browser PNG; no resizing or sharpening

title: Start from a flow template
steps: Choose a template whose trigger and sequence fit the intended audience journey.
Review its steps before creating or changing a flow.
Replace linked content and review eligibility rules before activation.

capture.source: Native browser PNG; no resizing or sharpening

title: Inspect a flow before activation
steps: Review the entry trigger and the order of the steps.
Select each card to match it with Rules & Actions, then check its content, conditions, and timing.
Validate the flow and linked email drafts before activating it. Activation can affect future eligible connections.

capture.source: Native browser PNG; no resizing or sharpening

title: Read automation results
steps: Confirm the flow and reporting scope.
Select a row in Step analysis to filter Connection activity; combine the status and step filters when needed.
An empty report may simply mean that the flow has not run; inspect its status and trigger before changing it.

capture.source: Native browser PNG; no resizing or sharpening

title: Choose the right form type
steps: Use a hosted, embedded, popup, or landing-page form to fit the placement.
Open Results to review performance or Edit to change a draft.
Check the draft or published state before sharing a link or installing code.

capture.source: Native browser PNG; no resizing or sharpening

title: Edit a signup form
steps: Review the form fields, labels, and subscription choices.
Adjust the design and inspect the preview.
Save and complete the publishing checks before sharing the live form.

capture.source: Native browser PNG; no resizing or sharpening

title: Prepare an embedded form
steps: Configure the fields and appearance for the website placement.
Check consent and required fields before publishing.
Use the provided integration instructions, then test the published form on the target website.

capture.source: Native browser PNG; no resizing or sharpening

title: Configure a popup form
steps: Review the popup content and display controls.
Check both small-screen and desktop previews.
Save, publish when ready, and test the installed behavior on the intended website.

capture.source: Native browser PNG; no resizing or sharpening

title: Build a landing page
steps: Use a focused headline and a clear signup purpose.
Review images, fields, links, and the mobile layout.
Publish the completed version and test its public link before distributing it.

capture.source: Native browser PNG; no resizing or sharpening

title: Manage surveys and review results first
steps: Choose a starter or open an existing survey.
Use Results, the first row action, to review responses; use Edit to change the draft.
Read the resource status before sharing or changing a published survey.

capture.source: Native browser PNG; no resizing or sharpening

title: Review survey questions
steps: Use clear questions and appropriate response types.
Inspect answer choices, required settings, and the respondent preview.
Save and publish only after checking the complete respondent experience.

capture.source: Native browser PNG; no resizing or sharpening

title: Manage subscriber preferences
steps: Open the preferences resource for the audience.
Review the fields and groups subscribers may change.
Test the published experience and distinguish preference changes from unsubscribing.

capture.source: Native browser PNG; no resizing or sharpening

title: Interpret form and survey results
steps: Confirm the selected resource and date range.
Review available views, submissions, and response details.
Zero responses can be expected for an unpublished or unused form; verify the public link and filters.

capture.source: Native browser PNG; no resizing or sharpening

title: Triage incoming conversations
steps: Choose the conversation scope and use search or labels to find a thread.
Open a conversation and read its history before responding.
Use labels and Mark done to keep work organized.

capture.source: Native browser PNG; no resizing or sharpening

title: Review a conversation before replying
steps: Confirm the sender, subject, and conversation history.
Check the linked connection and any eligibility warning before composing a reply.
Save draft preserves work. Send reply is separate and checks eligibility and delivery readiness; this example shows the blocked state.

capture.source: Native browser PNG; no resizing or sharpening

title: Write a direct message
steps: Check the selected connection and permitted sending address.
Enter a clear subject and message, then review links and any template content.
Save the draft before leaving; only send when the recipient and delivery checks allow it.

capture.source: Native browser PNG; no resizing or sharpening

title: Reuse an Inbox message template
steps: Create a template for a recurring reply or open an existing one.
Personalize the inserted text for the current conversation.
Archive an obsolete template to remove it from active use while keeping history.

capture.source: Native browser PNG; no resizing or sharpening

title: Check Inbox receiving setup
steps: An administrator reviews the inbound source and routing status.
Complete the instructed external test when configuring a real account.
Keep receiving and outgoing delivery checks separate; this guide uses fictional local messages.

capture.source: Native browser PNG; no resizing or sharpening

title: Read email performance in context
steps: Confirm the reporting period, comparison, and message selection.
Read the definition and denominator of each metric.
Treat opens and clicks as observed signals; privacy proxies and automated scanners can affect them.

capture.source: Native browser PNG; no resizing or sharpening

title: Find and manage custom reports
steps: Search reports or use Favorites only and Removed reports to narrow the list.
Open a saved report and review its dataset, filters, and ownership or sharing.
Use Clear all to reset list filters when an expected report is missing.

capture.source: Native browser PNG; no resizing or sharpening

title: Review and share a saved custom report
steps: Review the dataset, grouping, metrics, and exact saved date range.
Change the scope and update the report to inspect a different question.
Check the private or shared setting before distributing a signed-in report link.

capture.source: Native browser PNG; no resizing or sharpening

title: Review audience growth
steps: Check the date window and the population represented.
Compare growth and subscription changes with the underlying activity.
Avoid adding overlapping categories or assuming that total connections equals eligible recipients.

capture.source: Native browser PNG; no resizing or sharpening

title: Prepare a writing request
steps: Choose a starter or describe the message and desired tone.
Provide the source text and only the context needed for the task.
Generate suggestions when the AI service is available, review the result, then deliberately copy or apply what you want to keep.

capture.source: Native browser PNG; no resizing or sharpening

title: Ask a question about analytics
steps: Start with a specific question about the current reporting scope.
Check the date range, filters, and evidence used in the answer.
Verify important conclusions against the underlying report before acting.

capture.source: Native browser PNG; no resizing or sharpening

title: Generate suggestions or check existing content

actions.value: Our next community gathering is November 14. Join us for conversation and time together.
Make this invitation warm and concise. Keep the date unchanged.

steps: Provide the source text and the specific change you need.
Choose Generate suggestions for writing alternatives, or Check content for a review.
Check every factual detail in the result and save your chosen text in the actual draft. The example request shown has not been submitted.

capture.source: Native browser PNG; no resizing or sharpening

title: Find an answer when you are stuck
steps: Search for the task or symptom rather than an entire error message.
Open the relevant topic and follow its checks in order.
If the issue persists, record the page, action, and exact error for an administrator.

capture.source: Native browser PNG; no resizing or sharpening
